title: The Trap of the Rooftop Farm
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Conan, Takagi, Chiba, Inspector) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Old cases/ep588 file's culprit (Marie Inoue) and locked-room mechanic are confirmed correct against the transcript, but its motive text was imprecise: it says the victim 'destroyed crops grown from her late father's final harvest' -- the transcript actually has Inoue growing vegetables from seeds her late father left behind after dying of illness, and Nakamura mistaking the young, scraggly plants for weeds and killing them with herbicide, which is what triggered her rage. The old file also collapsed the murder into one `event` node with a single generic `was_used_in`/`knows` edge set; this rebuild decomposes it into the phone lure, the rope-and-brick rig, the water-tank strike, and the dying-message/paint-smudge/slip-of-tongue clues as separate typed edges, and adds the two red-herring suspects' own motives plus Inoue's father as a backstory node. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Paint smudge on the found towel's inner side matches the handrail's paint and is scraped as if rubbed hard against it, unlike Nakamura's own initialed towel around his neck -- shows a second, unmarked towel was rigged against the handrail itself.

Nakamura's dying finger-point was first read as indicating a facial-kanji clue among the three suspects' names, but the angle actually pointed downward to the floor below -- the true message was 'killed by the person living underneath.'
Before the police disclosed how Nakamura died, Inoue said he 'chose to hit his head and drop dead' -- a detail only the person who engineered that exact fall could have known.
